A man in a rust mantle indicates the well, while a woman in ochre offers a clay cup to a seated elderly woman. Olive branches frame stone houses and blue hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined village scene illustrates the instruction rather than a narrated event. The elder represents reminding believers; the man beside the well represents civic authority, and the willing helper suggests obedience and readiness for good work. Offering water gives that readiness a practical expression. The verse does not specify these people or this task.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three robed listeners sit beside an older speaker beneath an olive tree. A small empty wooden boat with a trailing rope floats off a stone landing on blue water, with sunlit hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative shoreline gathering pictures attentive hearing; it is not an event narrated in Hebrews. The empty boat and loose rope make the warning against drifting visible. The ordinary speaker is not a portrayal of Jesus or God. The verse calls us to attend more earnestly to what we have heard.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three robed travelers stand by an open stone archway. A bowed man holds his pack strap while a concerned companion extends an open hand toward him. A woman waits inside an olive garden with flowering plants, stone benches and a small stream, all painted in warm watercolor.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined journey pictures the remaining promise of rest through an open entrance into a peaceful garden. The paused traveler and his concerned companion suggest the warning that any hearer might fall short. The garden is an earthly visual metaphor, not a literal depiction of God's rest, and no traveler is shown finally excluded.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Five adults in earth-toned robes sit around a wooden table in a sunlit stone courtyard. A travel staff and leather satchel lie beside folded white cloth, blue-and-gold fabric and a jeweled breastpiece. Olive branches, flowers, clay vessels and distant hills surround the gathering.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering expresses shared calling and careful contemplation; the verse does not narrate such a meeting. The staff and satchel evoke a sent one, while the priestly textiles and breastpiece evoke the high-priestly office. Together they point indirectly to the two titles given to Jesus, who is not depicted. The objects are illustrative, not claimed relics. Human artwork review remains pending.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men in long linen tunics lift a limestone block together onto a rising house wall. Large foundation stones support the walls; a wooden doorway and scaffold stand to the right. An olive tree, distant hills, spare stones, a mallet and a basket complete the warm watercolor scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined building scene illustrates the verse's foundation language: the builders raise walls on an established base instead of laying it again. Their upward progress suggests maturity beyond elementary teaching. The foundation recalls repentance from dead works and faith in God; the workers are ordinary people, not figures identified by the verse. The picture does not suggest that construction work earns salvation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowned, bearded man in cream and burgundy raises his hand over a gray-bearded traveler with bowed head. Three men and a laden donkey approach along a rocky path beside an olive tree and stone hill town, in warm sunset light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative reconstruction centers the blessing named in the verse. The bowed traveler is Abraham; the man with a circlet is Melchizedek, a human king and priest. The settlement, clothing, companions and donkey supply an imagined setting, not details asserted by this verse. Abraham returns from the slaughter of the kings; that violence remains offstage. No figure represents God.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A watercolor priest in a cream turban, blue robe and jeweled breastpiece carries a bowl of grain toward a smoking bronze altar. Four robed worshippers and a pale young goat wait behind him. A grain basket and lidded vessel stand nearby, with a curtained sanctuary beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative sanctuary scene places an unnamed high priest between worshippers and an altar to show his service on their behalf. The grain gift and living goat awaiting sacrifice point to gifts and sacrifices for sins; no slaughter is shown. The verse describes the office generally, rather than this particular gathering. God is not pictured.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of a desert sanctuary tent with a closed blue, purple, red and cream entrance curtain. A bronze basin, two pitchers and a small bowl stand in the sandy courtyard, enclosed by linen hangings, with ochre hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative tabernacle setting illustrates the earthly sanctuary named in the verse. The basin and neatly arranged vessels suggest ordered worship; their particular appearance and placement are illustrative details, not descriptions supplied by this verse. The closed curtain keeps the interior unseen.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A white-robed forearm and hand rest on a carved golden chair arm at left. Pale steps rise through pink and lavender clouds to a large throne filled with golden-white light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative view uses the resting hand and robe edge to suggest the seated high priest, with the honor seat on the right of the great throne (the viewer's left). Unfigured radiance keeps the Majesty unportrayed. The furnishings and clouds are artistic aids, not a claimed description of heaven; the verse's point is our high priest's exalted seat.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in an ochre robe and cream headscarf sits on a stone terrace beneath an olive tree, holding seeds in her open palm. A terracotta seed bowl rests beside her. Flowers and garden beds overlook a misty valley under a warm sunrise.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative garden scene illustrates abstract teaching, not a narrated event. Seeds suggest a harvest still hoped for; the firm stone seat and calm posture suggest assurance, while the mist conceals what lies beyond sight. The woman and garden are artistic analogies, not people or objects specified by the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A gray-haired man and a younger bearded man sit close with hands resting on a shoulder and forearm; a veiled woman smiles beside them. Bread, three cups and a clay jug sit on a low table beneath an olive tree in a sunlit stone courtyard, with hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard fellowship gives visible form to the command to let brotherly love remain. The men's gentle gestures and the woman's shared warmth suggest lasting care within the family of believers. The people, setting and meal are illustrative details, not an event described by this verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three sandaled adults in simple tunics run along a rocky, sunlit hillside path. A pack, cloak and tangled rope lie behind them. A large gathering lines the distant slopes, with an olive tree, wildflowers and blue mountains framing the warm watercolor scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative race illustrates the call to persevere. The discarded pack and cloak picture hindrances; the tangled rope pictures entangling sin, without making those objects sinful. The surrounding multitude evokes the cloud of witnesses and their testimony. It is not a recorded race or a claim that departed people literally watch believers. All runners are ordinary people.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an elderly woman opens her hands toward two men seated together on one low bench. One wears a patched ochre tunic and the other a blue-green tunic with a brown mantle. A woman and another man sit nearby beneath olive branches.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering illustrates the command against partiality through equal seating and a shared welcome for people whose clothing suggests differing means. The verse gives an instruction, not this particular event. The scene keeps Jesus out of view; its ordinary sunlight does not depict God or Christ's glory.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A gray-bearded man with one hand on his chest sits beside a blank parchment scroll as three adults listen in a sunlit stone courtyard. A bronze balance on the wooden table has a stone weighing down one pan. An olive tree shades the warm watercolor scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering connects the teacher's humble pause and the listeners' restraint with James's warning that not many should become teachers. The stone-weighted balance is an added visual metaphor for the greater judgment teachers will receive; neither the scale nor this gathering is described as an event in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two bearded men in long robes quarrel across a low wooden table beneath an olive tree. One holds a red patterned cloth and points; the other clutches a pouch and reaches toward him. Bread and a clay jug sit between them in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The imagined dispute over cloth and a purse gives visible form to the link James makes between inward pleasures and outward quarrels. Possessive grips close to the chest and accusing or reaching hands suggest desires driving conflict. The verse does not describe this particular incident or limit its warning to possessions.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two richly robed men grieve in a stone courtyard. One sits bowed with a hand over his tearful face; the other lifts his face and open hands in lament. An open coffer of gold coins and folded patterned cloth lie on a table beside storage jars, with dark clouds over distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard gives visible form to the rich people addressed and their commanded weeping and wailing. The intact coins and fine cloth identify their wealth without bringing in a particular historical event. Approaching storm clouds are an artistic metaphor for the coming miseries, not a prediction of literal weather. The scene preserves the warning rather than depicting a promised rescue.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A head-covered woman in terracotta clothing offers bread to a bearded man holding a clay cup. They sit at a stone table with olives and a pitcher beneath a leafy vine in a sunlit courtyard, painted in warm, textured watercolor.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household scene illustrates the wife's respectful submission through quiet conduct and her husband's attentive response. The offered bread is an invented everyday detail suggesting how conduct may win him without spoken persuasion. Peter does not describe this meal or identify this couple, and the image does not claim that a conversion has occurred.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in a blue-gray tunic kneels in a sunlit stone courtyard, lowering a russet cloak into a woven basket containing a pale theatrical mask, tangled cord and thorn branches. An olive tree, orange flowers and a clay jar surround him; a stone arch opens onto a bright path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard is not an event narrated in the verse. Setting aside the cloak pictures renouncing all five named vices. The mask and tangled cord echo hypocrisy and deceit; the thorns evoke the harm of malice, envy and slander. These are artistic associations, not literal definitions. The man represents an ordinary believer, not Jesus.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman rests her hand on a man's arm beside a stone shelter and a wooden shield. Both wear patched cream robes and rust-colored shawls. A rocky, flower-edged path climbs toward an empty cross on a distant hill under a warm sunrise.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imagined meditation, not an event narrated in the verse. The empty cross recalls Christ's bodily suffering; the shield pictures arming the mind with resolve, not fighting. The travelers' choice of the rough path suggests costly obedience and a break with sin. The verse does not name these people, shelter or landscape.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard beneath an olive tree, one robed man addresses four seated listeners while passing a small rolled parchment to another man. An open scroll rests on a stone table behind them. Cracked slabs and falling stones expose a hollow beneath the two standing men.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative gathering illustrates a warning, not a narrated event. The discreet scroll exchange suggests teaching introduced secretly; the collapsing paving beneath the teachers suggests destruction they bring on themselves. The open scroll recalls entrusted teaching. The verse also says they deny the Master who bought them; neither the Master nor that purchase is pictured.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four older men in earth-colored robes sit in a stone courtyard. A gray-bearded man in terracotta rests one hand on his chest and extends the other toward his listeners. A rolled parchment lies on a low wooden table. Olive branches frame the scene, and golden sunrise lights distant hills through a doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering gives visual form to Peter's appeal as a fellow elder, without claiming that this meeting occurred. His hand on his chest and sober expression suggest personal witness to Christ's sufferings; the shared seating expresses fellowship. The natural dawn suggests hope in glory still to be revealed, not a visible divine manifestation. Christ remains outside the picture.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Six adults and a child gather beneath an olive tree in a sunlit stone courtyard. They smile, clasp hands and lift open palms; travelers walk along a village lane behind them. Warm watercolor washes and fine contours describe cream, rose, olive and blue robes.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined fellowship pictures believers' joyful belonging as God's children; it is not an event narrated by the verse. The adults and child suggest a spiritual family rather than literal childhood alone. Unobservant travelers echo the world's failure to recognize them. The verse grounds that failure in not knowing Him; the picture cannot show that inward reality. No figure represents God or Jesus.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A rolled papyrus tied with cord rests beside an open blank sheet on a wooden table. A reed pen, dark inkpot, burning clay lamp and folded linen surround them. Morning light enters a stone window overlooking an olive tree and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The two papyrus letters recall Peter's first and second letters. Morning light suggests the awakening of sincere thought through remembrance. This still life is imaginative; the verse does not describe a table, lamp, landscape or time of day.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly gray-bearded writer holds a reed pen over an unmarked scroll while a younger man in a blue-green robe bows with clasped hands beside him. Warm sunlight fills a stone room opening onto an olive courtyard; clay vessels and an oil lamp surround the wooden table.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined meeting pairs John's loving written warning against sin with a believer's contrition and hope. The elder is only the letter writer, not the advocate or the Father. Jesus Christ's righteous advocacy remains unseen; ordinary morning light supports the hopeful mood rather than depicting God.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four robed adults smile together in a sunlit stone courtyard. A man in blue rests his hand on a seated man's shoulder, a woman offers bread, and another gestures toward an empty chair. Clay cups, a jug, olives, flowers and distant hills surround the table.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering evokes the family love that accompanies faith in Jesus as the Christ and birth from God. The shared bread, welcome and offered seat express care for fellow believers. The verse gives a teaching, not this particular event; the people are ordinary believers, and neither God nor Jesus is depicted.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of seven flaming golden oil-lamp stands arranged around an empty stone aisle beneath seven bright stars. A blank scroll and reed pen lie on a foreground ledge, with clay jars, stone arches and leafy branches at the sides.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative arrangement places the seven golden lampstands around an open aisle. Seven stars recall those held in Christ's right hand, and the blank scroll recalls the command to write to Ephesus. Christ and His hand remain unpictured. The chamber, scroll placement and stars suspended above the lamps are artistic arrangements, not details asserted by the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Warm watercolor of three robed adults gathered over a blank scroll at a wooden table, listening thoughtfully to a standing traveler. An older man raises an open hand. A clay lamp and jug sit nearby; flowering vines frame a stone arch overlooking a sunlit town and two distant groups listening to speakers.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The imagined courtyard gathering pictures believers carefully weighing a teacher's message. The open scroll suggests thoughtful examination, and distant speakers recall false prophets going into the world. The verse commands testing spiritual claims, but does not describe this meeting or identify these pictured people as true or false prophets. No spirit or divine figure is shown.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man in a cream robe and brown mantle stands on a rocky ledge, seen from behind with one hand raised. Above him, a wooden door stands open within a stone arch amid blue and lavender clouds, revealing brilliant golden light. Warm watercolor washes and fine contours cover textured paper.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The open doorway pictures the door John sees in heaven, while his attentive upward gaze suggests the invitation to come up. His age, clothing, rocky ledge and the doorway materials are imaginative setting details, not details specified in this verse. The golden light leaves the speaker unseen; it is not a portrait of God. No instrument is shown because the verse compares the voice to a trumpet.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A rolled ivory parchment scroll bears seven intact red wax seals on separate bands. Golden arches and columns rise through soft clouds and warm radiant light in a textured watercolor scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative object study centers the scroll and seven seals of John's vision. Golden architecture and light suggest the throne setting without depicting its occupant. The supporting right hand and the writing on both sides remain unpictured; the scroll has not been opened.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Four winged angels in long ivory robes stand on rocky ridges around a still blue inlet. Each raises both hands toward pale curling air. Olive trees, cypresses, golden hills, and a softly clouded sky fill the warm watercolor landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The four figures and checked air curls imagine the angels restraining the four winds, while the quiet land, sea, and upright trees picture the verse's resulting stillness. The coastal landscape, traditional wings, and four-direction placement are artistic choices, not details specified by the Greek or a claim about the earth's shape.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A large parchment scroll rests amid gold and violet clouds, with six red wax seals intact and two broken wax pieces beside a loosened cord. Below, a man in a rust-red cloak and cream robe faces the scroll with a hand beside his ear.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative, indirect composition focuses on the seal just opened by the Lamb, who remains outside the picture. John listens while the speaking living creature is also unseen. The luminous cloud folds suggest the thunderlike voice; the cloud setting and visual arrangement are artistic choices, not details specified by this verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An opened, blank golden parchment scroll rests on a pale stone ledge above softly layered peach, ivory and lavender clouds. A red wax seal lies broken in two beside a loose cord, beneath a wide, glowing sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The broken seal evokes the opened seventh seal, while the wide, motionless heavenly scene suggests the silence that follows. The scroll, stone ledge and clouds are an imaginative setting; the image does not measure the stated half hour. The opener is kept outside the frame.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A radiant cloud-cloaked figure descends among lavender and blue clouds, with a rainbow above its sun-bright head and two golden-orange columns of fire below its flowing cloud mantle.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The cloud mantle, sun-bright head, rainbow and paired fire columns imaginatively render John's description of the mighty angel. The face is hidden in radiance, without assigning a human likeness or identifying the messenger beyond the verse. The cloud shapes and colors are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed, winged angel blows a brass trumpet above a rocky twilight landscape. A glowing golden star rests on the ground beneath a floating bronze key, beside a circular stone shaft closed by a heavy lid and ironwork.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The radiant star on the earth and suspended key form an imaginative rendering of the vision, without assigning the star a personal identity. The trumpeting angel evokes the fifth trumpet. The stone lid and ironwork are artistic devices for the abyss's shaft; its depth and the giver of the key remain unseen.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man in ivory and rust robes holds a long reed in a sunlit stone sanctuary court. Four worshippers kneel before a pale altar framed by a deep doorway and columns. Warm watercolor washes reveal textured paper.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative temple setting pictures John holding the measuring reed before an altar and kneeling worshippers, bringing together the three subjects he is commanded to measure. The architecture and appearances are artistic choices. The speaker remains unseen; the image does not settle the prophetic meaning of the measuring.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A copper-scaled beast with seven long-necked heads and ten gold-crowned horns rises through foaming teal waves. Shore rocks fill the foreground beneath an ochre horizon and clouded blue sky, painted in textured watercolor.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative rendering gives the visionary beast seven distinct heads and ten horns, each bearing a royal diadem. Its copper scales, long necks, coastal viewpoint and warm light are artistic choices, not details specified by the verse. The blasphemous names on the heads are left unrendered to keep the image free of lettering; they remain explicit in the verse explanation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A veiled woman in flowing golden robes stands above a silver-blue crescent moon amid peach and lavender clouds. A radiant sun shines behind her, and a circlet of golden stars arches over her head.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative rendering follows the heavenly sign: sunlight surrounds the woman's modest robe, the crescent lies beneath her feet, and twelve stars crown her head, one partly obscured by her profile. The robe, veil, colors and clouds are artistic choices. The image does not identify the woman or portray God.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A white lamb stands on a rocky rise amid a vast crowd in pale, earth-toned robes. Foreground figures look toward it as the gathering spreads across terraced hills beneath peach clouds and golden light. Fine contours and warm watercolor washes reveal paper texture.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The lamb follows the verse's own visionary image of Christ. The rocky hill and immense gathering imaginatively evoke Mount Zion and the 144,000 without claiming an exact visual count. The verse says His name and His Father's name are written on their foreheads; those names are explained here rather than painted, preserving the requirement for no lettering.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Seven winged, ivory-robed figures hold golden bowls on cloud-wreathed steps before an open, radiant sanctuary. Some look toward the light while others face the landscape below, where ochre mountains, green valleys, and a blue coastline stretch into the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The seven angels holding seven bowls illustrate the command to pour out God's wrath upon the earth. Their attentive and departing poses picture the moment of instruction, before any pouring or particular plague is shown. The cloud stairway, radiant architecture, wings, robes, and distant coastline are imaginative visual choices, not details stated in this verse. The voice's speaker remains unseen; the light is not a portrait of God.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Seven winged angels in long ivory robes stand among purple clouds beneath a golden sky. Each has a dark, ember-lit cloud before their hands. Fine brown contours, warm watercolor washes and textured paper give the scene a solemn storybook appearance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The seven angels follow John's heavenly sign. The dark, ember-lit clouds before them imaginatively suggest the seven last plagues and God's wrath, whose completion the verse announces; the verse does not describe the plagues as clouds. Robes, wings and arrangement are artistic choices. God is not depicted.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A white-robed, winged angel holds a golden bowl and gestures across blue waterways. An older bearded man in brown stands beside him. Far away, a woman in a long purple robe sits on a stone seat beneath dark clouds.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The angel's bowl and invitation follow the verse. The branching waterways and distant, fully clothed seated woman imaginatively picture the announced many waters and great prostitute. The rocky bank, wings, stone seat, clothing colors, and gathering clouds are artistic choices; the scene does not claim to show the manner of her punishment.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed, winged angel seen from behind descends among pale clouds. Golden radiance fans across green and ochre hills, a winding river and distant blue water, with sunlit rocks and trees in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The descending messenger and the radiance spreading across the land illustrate the angel's descent and the earth illuminated by his glory. The wings, robe, clouds and particular landscape are imaginative visual details, not details specified by the verse. The angel represents the heavenly messenger, not God or Jesus.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Seen from behind, a winged angel in an ivory robe and gold sash carries a large iron key and loops of heavy chain above ochre rocks beside a deep blue-violet pit. Warm light streams through cream and blue clouds.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The descending messenger, key and great chain follow John's vision. Wings, robe colors and the rocky opening are imaginative details; the opening makes the abyss visible without claiming its appearance is described. The scene stops before any binding or later action.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A vast crowd in cream and rose robes looks upward in joyful praise beneath luminous golden clouds. Foreground worshippers raise open hands or hold them over their hearts, while rows of figures recede into the distance. Fine contours and textured watercolor washes model faces and flowing fabric.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The imagined multitude gives visible form to the great heavenly voice the speaker hears. Shared upward gazes and gestures suggest the Hallelujah that ascribes salvation, glory and power to God. The clothing, faces and cloud setting are artistic choices; the verse describes what is heard, and God remains unseen.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man in a cream robe and rust mantle stands with open hands on pale rocks, looking across green meadows, flowering trees and distant lavender mountains beneath a vast blue sky with peach-gold clouds. Flowers fill the foreground; no sea is visible.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The expansive sky and sea-free land imaginatively evoke the new heaven and new earth John sees after the first have passed away. The elderly witness represents the seer saying "I saw." The flowers, trees, mountains and clothing are artistic details, not descriptions supplied by the verse; the picture does not show how the former creation passed away.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Clear turquoise water ripples over pale stones, flowing toward the viewer from a golden throne base surrounded by brilliant light. Cream-colored rocks, pink and white flowers, and vine-covered arches line the banks. No figures are visible.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The clear river flowing from the golden throne base pictures the verse's water of life proceeding from the throne of God and the Lamb. The upper throne is concealed in radiance so neither God nor Jesus is directly portrayed. The flowers, arches, stone banks, pebbles and small drop over the lowest step are imaginative details, not additional claims made by the verse. Human artwork review remains pending.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A watercolor of robed adults huddled in a dusty stone courtyard, leaning in with tense expressions and open hands. Behind them, a larger crowd gestures and argues beneath a pale blue sky; ocher hills and a village lie in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined ancient gathering pairs public agitation with a smaller group's intent discussion. Windblown courtyard dust suggests the futility of their schemes; the verse does not specify this setting or these individuals.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two honey-colored wooden lyres rest on linen and a woven mat in a sunlit stone courtyard. Olive branches frame the scene; a clay jug and bowl of olives sit at the left, with blue hills and a small village beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The two lyres evoke the heading's stringed accompaniment. The quiet courtyard and hills are an imaginative setting for preparing sacred music, not an event described in the text; the heading does not specify these instruments' exact shapes or a location.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded leader raises his hand toward a man and woman singing in a sunlit stone courtyard. All wear long robes. A rolled parchment rests on a bench beneath a leafy tree, with olive-covered hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The imagined music leader and singers connect the heading with a psalm prepared for musical performance. The courtyard is an artistic setting, not an event narrated by the verse; no person is identified as David. No particular instrument is inferred from the uncertain designation Nehiloth.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A gray-bearded man in a cream robe, rust-red mantle and sandals walks along a rocky path, looking back toward a distant walled hill city. An olive tree and small purple flowers frame the foreground, with layered blue hills beneath a softly glowing sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: David's movement away from the distant city imagines the flight named in the heading, while his backward glance suggests the sorrow of fleeing his own son. Absalom remains outside the picture. The olive-lined path, clothing and warm morning light are artistic setting choices, not details supplied by this verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A wooden lyre rests on a russet-and-cream cloth over a stone bench beneath an olive tree. Warm evening light fills a stone courtyard with a clay jar and small flowers, overlooking distant buildings and hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The imagined courtyard and waiting lyre evoke preparation for the string accompaniment named in the heading. The verse does not describe this setting or an event there. The instrument makes no claim about the number of strings or the precise musical meaning of Sheminith.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in cream robes and a russet mantle sits on limestone beneath an olive tree, holding a wooden lyre and looking upward with his mouth open. Small wildflowers dot the rocks, and blue-gold hills stretch beneath a softly lit sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: David's upward gaze and song visualize the heading's statement that he sang to the LORD concerning Cush the Benjaminite. The lyre, olive tree and hillside are imaginative setting details, not reported facts; Cush and the unspecified encounter are not shown. Shiggaion is retained without claiming a certain musical form. God is not pictured.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A wooden lyre leans against a sunlit stone bench beside a tied parchment roll and cream linen. Olive branches and small flowers frame golden hills under a blue sky in a textured watercolor scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative still life evokes the musical heading through a lyre and a closed parchment roll. It does not depict a recorded event or identify the lyre as the Gittith. The courtyard and peaceful landscape provide a setting for contemplating a psalm associated with David; they are artistic choices, not details stated by this verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A wooden lyre and round frame drum lean against a sunlit stone bench. A rolled scroll rests on the bench, with a leafy clay pot and small flowers nearby. Beyond the courtyard wall, olive trees and blue hills stretch into the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The instruments waiting in a quiet courtyard imaginatively evoke the musical heading and its psalm of David. Neither this setting nor these particular instruments is specified in the verse; the obscure performance designation is not turned into an invented event.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a cream robe and rust-colored mantle kneels on a rocky ledge, looking upward with open hands. An olive tree and dry grasses stand beside him; a path winds through layered hills beneath gray-lavender clouds and rain haze.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The worshipper and valley are an imaginative composition, not a specific event named in the verse. His questioning upward gaze and open hands express the lament. The long distance and cloud-veiled hills suggest the speaker's experience of hiddenness in trouble without depicting God or claiming that He is absent. No answer or rescue is pictured.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a cream robe and golden mantle stands with his hand on his chest. Two robed companions gesture beside pale rocks under an olive tree. A brown bird flies above a winding hillside path toward distant mountains.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined hillside gathering gives visible form to the verse's dialogue: the companions' gestures and the mountainward bird suggest the urged flight, while the psalmist's steady stance conveys his declared refuge in the LORD. The landscape is a poetic setting, not an identified historical event; neither the rock nor the bird depicts God.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A wooden lyre rests on a russet and cream woven cloth on a sunlit stone ledge. Olive branches and small flowers surround it; a clay jar and stone arch stand behind, with green hills and distant houses beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The lyre imaginatively evokes the psalm and its musical direction. The courtyard, cloth and landscape provide a contemplative setting; the heading does not describe these objects or a particular performance. The image illustrates the musical superscription, without importing the following lament or claiming to reconstruct an event.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A honey-colored wooden lyre with a carved leafy ornament rests on a cream woven cloth in a sunlit stone courtyard. A clay jug stands beside it, olive branches arch overhead, and pale buildings dot distant violet hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The resting lyre imaginatively evokes the heading's musical purpose. The courtyard and instrument are illustrative choices, not details stated by the verse. The visible string count does not interpret the musical direction Sheminith.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed merchant rests one hand on his chest and the other beside coins at a stone table. An uneven bronze balance and a bowl of figs and grapes stand nearby, including a split fig with a dark center. Two robed adults walk away past a tipped basket and scattered grain in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined marketplace gives visible form to an inward moral refusal: the hand at the chest evokes the fool speaking in his heart, while coins, an uneven balance, spoiled fruit and unattended grain suggest corrupt deeds. These illustrative details are not events specified by the verse. No figure is presented as a righteous exception, and God is not pictured.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a cream robe and russet cloak kneels beneath a limestone overhang, gazing upward with open hands. Olive trees, wildflowers, a winding path, distant stone buildings and sunlit hills fill the warm watercolor landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The praying man imagines the psalmist's appeal for preservation. The rocky shelter gives visual form to taking refuge in God; neither this setting nor a particular event is specified by the verse. God remains unseen.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a cream robe and russet mantle kneels on a rocky ledge, lifting open hands and an earnest face toward the sky. Olive branches, small wildflowers and rolling hills surround him in warm dawn light, painted in textured watercolor.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: David kneeling with open hands imaginatively expresses his urgent, sincere appeal for the LORD to hear his just cause and prayer without deceit. The hillside, olive tree and dawn are illustrative choices; the verse specifies no location or time. The natural light conveys quiet hope without depicting God or claiming that an answer has already come.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A pilgrim in a cream robe and rust-colored mantle stands on a winding stone path, facing a linen tent on a sunlit hill. Olive trees, wildflowers and limestone rocks frame the scene, with blue hills beneath a golden sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The hilltop tent brings together the verse's parallel images of the LORD's tent and holy hill. The anonymous pilgrim pauses outside, suggesting the question of who may dwell there without depicting admission. This is an imaginative setting, not a narrated event or an archaeological reconstruction; God is not depicted.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a cream robe and russet mantle sits beneath an olive tree, holding a wooden lyre and looking upward with a joyful expression. Golden grasses and small flowers surround the limestone ledge, overlooking a winding rocky valley and distant hills beneath warm clouds.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: David's upward gaze and lyre imagine his thankful song to the LORD after deliverance from his enemies and Saul. The peaceful hillside suggests safety after danger. The verse does not specify this setting, instrument or posture; these are illustrative choices, not a reconstruction of a particular rescue. God is not pictured.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A wooden lyre and round frame drum rest on cream linen beside a slender wooden pick in a sunlit stone courtyard. Olive branches arch overhead, small flowers grow along the stones, and soft blue hills stretch into the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The instruments prepared for music imaginatively evoke the heading that entrusts a psalm of David to the chief musician. The courtyard, linen and morning light are artistic setting choices, not details stated in the verse; no particular performance or historical event is claimed.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A carved wooden lyre and tied parchment scroll rest on sunlit stone, framed by olive branches. A clay jug stands behind them, with ochre hills beyond a low courtyard wall.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The lyre and closed scroll imagine preparations for sacred music, linking the psalm's musical heading and its association with David. The courtyard, objects and afternoon light are illustrative choices, not details narrated by the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Cream-colored sheep graze and rest beneath an olive tree among grass, wildflowers and pale rocks. At the center, a ewe nuzzles a lamb. A wooden shepherd's crook leans against the trunk, with golden hills stretching into the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The sheep picture the speaker's dependence and contentment; the crook evokes shepherding care without depicting the LORD. The pastoral setting and ewe with lamb are imaginative details, not events reported in this verse. They illustrate trust in the LORD's sufficient care.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A wooden lyre and frame drum rest on cream and ochre woven cloth on a limestone bench. A clay jar, olive branches and small flowers frame the sunlit courtyard, with olive groves, stone houses and lavender hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The lyre and frame drum form an imagined musical setting for the superscription addressed to the music director and associated with David. The courtyard and landscape are artistic choices, not events or locations stated in this verse. Human artwork review remains pending.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A doe stands beside a wooden lyre resting on ochre cloth against limestone, beneath an olive tree. Wildflowers surround them, and warm sunrise lights misty, lavender hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The lyre evokes the heading's musical direction, while the doe and sunrise give an imaginative setting to 'The Doe of the Dawn.' The verse does not narrate this scene or identify the title's precise musical meaning; the image illustrates the heading rather than a historical encounter.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a cream robe and terracotta mantle walks on a sunlit stone path, looking upward with open hands. Olive trees, limestone terraces, golden grasses and wildflowers surround him, with a village and layered hills in the distance. Warm watercolor washes reveal textured paper.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative setting, not a recorded episode. The man represents David: his lifted gaze and open hands evoke the appeal for vindication, while his steady walk on firm ground pictures integrity and trust in the LORD without slipping. The hillside and morning light supply a quiet setting; they do not portray God or a promised miracle.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a cream robe and rust-brown mantle kneels beside rocks and an olive tree, lifting open hands and looking upward. Small flowers surround him, and warm dawn light falls across distant hills beneath a softly clouded sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: David is imagined praying on a hillside. His upward gaze and empty, lifted hands express the verse's lifting of his soul toward the LORD; the soul is not pictured as a separate object. The landscape and dawn are an imaginative setting, not details stated in the verse. God is not depicted.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor landscape framed by olive and fig trees, with wildflowers, grazing sheep, a family walking down a path, and villagers harvesting grain and tending vegetables. A river winds through fields and stone villages toward blue water and distant mountains.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The imagined valley gathers land, water, plants, animals, and human inhabitants into one abundant vista to evoke the earth and its fullness belonging to the LORD. It illustrates the verse's declaration rather than a narrated event or an identified location; God is not pictured.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a cream robe and ochre mantle kneels with open hands raised beside a sunlit rock. A dark hollow opens in the stony ground to his right, with sparse plants, distant hills and a pale blue sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The imagined rocky landscape gives visual form to David's appeal to the LORD as his Rock. The praying figure expresses his urgent cry; the dark hollow recalls his fear of joining those who descend to the pit. This is a meditation on the verse, not a recorded location or a depiction of God, and no answer to the plea is shown.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling bearded man in a cream robe, russet cloak and sandals stands beneath a limestone overhang. Olive branches hang above him, wildflowers grow among the rocks, and golden dawn lights the distant hills and valley.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined psalmist and dawn-lit rocky refuge give visible form to the LORD as light, salvation and life's strength. The verse names no outdoor setting or rescue event. The sunrise and shelter are visual analogies for trust in the LORD; neither portrays God.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Five robed men, three standing and two kneeling, lift open hands or bow on a flower-dotted rocky height. Golden light edges towering clouds above distant blue hills; cream, ochre, rust and blue garments glow in the textured watercolor.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The five worshippers imaginatively embody the summons addressed to the 'sons of the mighty'; the verse does not specify these people or this hilltop gathering. Open hands express ascribing glory and strength to Yahweh, while the vast sky and hills suggest majesty. God remains unseen.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A wooden lyre leans against a linen-draped stool beside an open wooden door in a sunlit stone courtyard. An olive tree shades the paving; clay vessels, a dim interior and distant hills complete the warm watercolor scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The lyre evokes the heading's psalm and song, while the open house doorway evokes the dedication of the house. This is an imaginative still-life setting, not a reconstruction of a recorded ceremony or a claim about which house was dedicated. David is named by the heading but is not pictured.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A carved wooden lyre and a tied parchment roll rest on linen across a sunlit stone bench. Olive branches hang overhead; white, yellow and purple flowers grow nearby. A clay jar stands behind the bench, with hills and a stone village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The lyre and closed scroll imaginatively reflect the heading's musical direction and association with David. The peaceful courtyard provides a setting for contemplating a psalm; the verse does not describe these particular objects or a historical scene.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in cream and terracotta robes sits beneath an olive tree, looking upward with open hands. A bulky pack with loose straps rests beside him beneath an ivory cloth. Wildflowers, a stone wall, olive groves, distant hills and small buildings glow in warm morning light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene gives visible form to the blessing of forgiveness. The resting man and set-down pack suggest relief from the burden of transgression; the cloth over the pack echoes sin being covered. The verse describes forgiveness, not a literal bundle or an event in this garden. Neither the cloth nor the man earns pardon. God is not pictured.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a cream tunic and rust-colored mantle kneels with open hands raised beneath an olive tree. Across a rocky hollow, one of three men points toward him while two hold spears. Warm light falls on dry grasses, small flowers and layered hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The kneeling man represents David appealing to the unseen LORD. The accusing gesture and spears visualize the two related pleas: contend with his adversaries and fight those who fight him. The hillside and arrangement are imaginative, not a particular event described in the verse; the painting shows the appeal rather than an accomplished victory.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a cream robe and russet mantle steps through a sunlit stone gateway, glancing back toward a seated ruler in blue who extends one hand. Beyond the open wooden doors, a rocky path leads among olive trees toward hills and a distant village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative reconstruction of David leaving after Abimelech drove him away. The ruler's dismissive gesture and David's backward glance connect the scene to the heading; architecture, clothing and gestures are artistic choices. The scene concentrates on his departure rather than depicting the changed behavior in detail. Human artwork review remains pending.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Six adults in earth-colored robes sing together on a sunlit stone terrace beneath an olive tree. An elder lifts an open hand while a woman holds hers over her heart. Rolling hills and small stone buildings lie behind them, with pink flowers in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering gives visual form to the call for righteous people to rejoice in the LORD and the fitting beauty of their praise. The verse names no particular gathering or location; the terrace, olive tree and arrangement of singers are illustrative. God is not depicted.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A wooden lyre with carved leafy branches stands beside a blank parchment scroll and a rust-colored woven mantle on a limestone bench. An olive tree, sunlit courtyard and distant hills complete the warm watercolor scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The lyre and blank scroll imaginatively connect the heading with a song entrusted to musical direction. The simple mantle suggests humble service, echoing David being called the LORD's servant. The courtyard and objects are an artistic setting, not an event or precise instrument described by this verse. Human artwork review remains pending.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A wooden lyre leans against a limestone bench beside a blank unfurled scroll and a burning terracotta oil lamp. A clay jar stands behind it, olive branches frame the courtyard, and sunlit hills appear through the opening. Warm watercolor washes reveal textured paper.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative still life connects the heading's psalm and remembrance: the lyre evokes music, while the blank scroll suggests keeping and recalling a song. The lamp, courtyard and olive landscape provide a contemplative setting; they are artistic choices, not details stated in the verse or a claimed episode from David's life.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in an ochre robe and blue mantle sits beneath an olive tree with relaxed hands. Beside a sunlit village lane, a customer holds a grain basket while a merchant presses a finger into one pan of a hanging balance. Flowers, stone walls and distant hills surround the market.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The quiet seated figure contrasts with a merchant's finger pressing a balance pan. This imagined market scene relates the warning against fretting over evildoers and envying injustice to a choice of composure rather than imitation. The verse does not describe this transaction or identify the seated figure; this is not a recorded incident from David's life.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A wooden lyre, round hand drum and two bronze cymbals rest in a sunlit stone courtyard. A tied parchment roll lies on folded linen beside a clay jar, beneath olive branches, with wildflowers and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The lyre, drum and cymbals form an imaginative setting for the heading's musical direction; the tied parchment suggests the psalm associated with David. The verse does not describe this courtyard or name these instruments, and no historical performance is claimed.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A wooden lyre rests beside an empty wooden stool draped with cream linen on a sunlit stone terrace. Olive branches arch overhead, small flowers grow among the stones, and pale hills and stone houses stretch into the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The lyre and empty seat form an imaginative setting for this musical heading and its attribution to David. They do not reconstruct a documented occasion or claim to show his possessions. The stillness suggests readiness to perform the psalm.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A wooden lyre rests on cream linen beside a blank rolled parchment and a terracotta jar. Olive branches shade a sunlit stone courtyard overlooking blue-purple hills and a distant village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The lyre and blank rolled parchment imaginatively suggest a psalm prepared for musical performance. The heading names Jeduthun and David but does not describe this courtyard, these objects, or a particular meeting.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in a cream tunic, ochre mantle and head wrap sits on a stone overlooking green grasses and small wildflowers. Beside him, dry stalks feed a glowing earthen oven, with a tied bundle nearby. A stone wall, leafy tree, distant village and hills complete the warm watercolor landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined field-side setting places flourishing grass beside dry oven fuel to evoke today and tomorrow. The listener's plain clothing points to God's greater care for people, while his quiet contemplation invites trust rather than little faith. The verse supplies the comparison; the seated listener and setting are illustrative, not a recorded event.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: White lilies and closed buds grow among golden grasses. An ochre woven cloak, wooden spindle and pale wool rest on a foreground stone. An olive tree frames the sunlit field, with blue hills and small distant buildings beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative field composition invites the careful observation Jesus commands. The growing lilies stand beside a folded cloak and idle spindle with wool, connecting their unlabored growth with His question about anxiety over clothing. The arranged objects and landscape are illustrative choices, not an event or precise flower species identified by the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: White and blush lilies bloom beside a limestone bench draped with burgundy and purple cloth embroidered in gold. A gold circlet rests on the stone. Small pink and white flowers, an olive tree, distant hills and pale buildings fill the sunlit watercolor garden.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative arrangement places living lilies beside royal clothing and a circlet to illustrate the comparison with Solomon in all his glory. It does not depict a recorded visit by Solomon. The flowers evoke the lilies referred to by "one of these" in the teaching; the robe and circlet stand for royal splendor. Jesus remains outside the image.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of a torn loaf on a woven tray, an earthenware pitcher and water-filled cup, and an ochre fringed cloak on a stone ledge beneath an olive tree. A path curves through golden grass toward a blue lake and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative still life places bread, water and a plain cloak together for the three daily needs named in Matthew 6:31. Its quiet landscape invites reflection on Jesus' command not to be anxious. The verse does not describe this arrangement or promise a life of material abundance.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of a loaf in a woven basket, a terracotta pitcher and cup, and folded linen with an ochre mantle on a sunlit stone ledge. Beneath an olive tree, villagers buy bread, fill a jar and examine cloth among pale stone houses and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined village market relates the nations' seeking to ordinary needs. Bread, water vessels and cloth give those needs visible form; their quiet foreground placement invites reflection on the Father's knowledge of them. The verse does not narrate this market scene, and neither the Father nor Jesus is depicted.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of a kneeling man praying beneath an olive tree while a young woman shares bread with an elderly woman. A bread basket, clay jug and folded striped cloak rest among wildflowers; a winding path leads toward a village and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined Galilean scene is not an event narrated in the verse. Prayer evokes seeking God's reign, and sharing bread suggests a life directed toward His righteousness. The simple bread, jug and cloak represent provision placed beside that first priority. These are illustrative relationships, not a literal picture of the kingdom or a transaction earning God's care.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler in earth-colored robes sits on a low stone wall beneath an olive tree, repairing a sandal in his lap. A clay flask and tied cloth bundle rest beside him. Wildflowers grow at his feet, and a rocky road winds through olive trees toward distant hills and a village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined traveler is not a person named in the verse. His worn sandal gives today's trouble a concrete form; the road disappearing into the hills suggests tomorrow, still unseen. His quiet attention to the repair illustrates refusing anxiety about tomorrow without denying today's hardship. The verse does not describe this scene or promise an easy future.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two robed men sit in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath olive branches. The man in rust reaches toward his neighbor, while an enormous squared timber projects from his own eye area. Small straw flecks lie near the olive-robed neighbor's eyes. A clay jug and distant blue hills complete the watercolor scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard illustrates Jesus' rhetorical comparison, rather than a recorded encounter. The would-be helper's enormous beam contrasts with the small straw near his neighbor's eyes, showing the blindness of correcting another while overlooking one's own greater fault. The timber is visual hyperbole without an injury; Jesus is outside the frame.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of a wooden grain measure filled to its rim between two matching terracotta bowls of grain. Two sleeved hands rest beside the bowls, and a leveling stick lies across the wooden table. An olive tree, flowers, a clay jug and sunlit stone walls surround the courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard still life uses one grain measure and two matching portions to picture the same standard applying to others and to ourselves. It illustrates Jesus' warning about judgment and accountability, rather than a recorded grain transaction or a promise of material gain. The visible hands belong to ordinary human neighbors.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit watercolor village path, a brown pig steps among scattered pearls while a darker pig turns toward a linen-sleeved hand holding a pouch. An alert dog stands behind them, with a stone wall, village houses, hills and blue water in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined tableau develops the warning rather than depicting a recorded event. Pearls beneath a pig's hoof show precious things being trampled; the turning pig and alert dog suggest danger to the giver. The withdrawing hand visualizes caution. The threatened tearing is conveyed indirectly, without showing an attack. Jesus is outside the scene, and the animals do not identify a particular human group.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man in a rust-colored mantle grips a massive wooden beam angled toward the ground. Beside him, a seated man in olive robes touches below his eye. An olive tree and a hillside village frame the warm watercolor scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard gives physical form to Jesus' beam-and-splinter comparison. The lowered beam and the first man's unobstructed face suggest dealing with his own great fault first, while the brother's eye gesture anticipates the smaller help that follows. The scene illustrates the metaphor rather than a recorded incident.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler in a cream robe, terracotta mantle and cloth head covering knocks at a partly opened wooden door in a golden stone house, holding the other palm open. Beyond the threshold is a sunlit courtyard with a clay jar and leafy vines. An olive tree, wildflowers, a stone path and a distant hillside village surround him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative village scene illustrates the teaching rather than a recorded encounter. The approaching path evokes seeking, the open palm suggests asking, and the knocking hand beside the opening door echoes the promised welcome. The traveler is an ordinary hearer; no visible figure represents Jesus or God.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Adult hands in cream sleeves offer an earthenware dish with a whole cooked fish toward a child's open hands. A brown patterned snake lies separately on a sunlit rock. Olive branches, a clay jar and a stone wall surround the warm, textured courtyard scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household vignette illustrates the verse's rhetorical contrast, rather than recording an event. The fish offered to the child represents the requested food; the serpent rests separately as the harmful alternative the question rejects. The hands belong to ordinary people, with neither Jesus nor God depicted.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling father in a russet tunic sits on a stone doorstep and offers a crusty loaf to a boy in an ochre tunic with open hands. A gray stone lies between them on the earth; clay jars, olive leaves and sunlit village walls surround the scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined Galilean household illustrates the human father-and-son example in Jesus' teaching. The offered bread answers the boy's need; the separate stone makes the rejected alternative visible. The verse does not report this particular encounter, and the father is an ordinary man, not a portrayal of God. Human artwork review remains pending.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young woman in a rust-red robe pours water from an earthenware pitcher into a cup held by an elderly woman in indigo and ochre. They smile in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath an olive tree, with bread, a walking staff, flowers and an open wooden gate nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined act of hospitality illustrates treating another person with the care one would wish to receive. The offered water, bread and shaded seat give ordinary form to the verse's active command; they are illustrative details, not a narrated event in Matthew 7:12. Jesus is not depicted.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded father in a brown robe offers a round loaf to a smiling child in a terracotta tunic. They sit in a sunlit stone courtyard beside a basket of bread and figs and a clay jug, with olive branches and distant hills behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined family scene illustrates the earthly comparison: a parent gives a useful, good gift to a child. The father is an ordinary human, not God or Jesus. The verse reasons from even evil people knowing how to give good gifts to the much greater goodness of the unseen heavenly Father toward those who ask Him; the courtyard and bread are illustrative details, not a recorded event.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor landscape with one olive-robed traveler entering a small stone gateway beside wildflowers. A crowd passes beneath a much wider arch onto a broad stone road through barren ruins toward a dark ravine. Sunlit green hills stretch beyond the narrow opening.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The two gateways and contrasting landscapes imaginatively visualize the command to enter the narrow gate and the warning that the broad road, entered by many, leads to destruction. The distant ruins and ravine represent that destructive destination without depicting anyone harmed. The scene illustrates a teaching rather than recording a historical event; Jesus is outside the picture.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three robed travelers seen from behind walk single file through a narrow stone gateway and up a rocky path toward sunlit green trees. Warm limestone, olive branches and small wildflowers fill the watercolor landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined landscape gives visible form to Jesus' teaching rather than depicting a recorded journey. The tight gateway and rough, confined path suggest the narrow, difficult way; the three separated travelers suggest the few who find it. Sunlit greenery evokes life without claiming to portray heaven or suggesting that a physical climb earns salvation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A gray-brown wolf creeps along a flower-lined path under a thick cream fleece, its ears, muzzle, teeth and paws exposed. Three sheep stand nearby; an olive tree, stone sheepfold, distant village and blue hills glow in warm sunlight.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The sheep's fleece conceals a predatory wolf, making visible the verse's contrast between false prophets' harmless appearance and their ravenous inward nature. The nearby flock gives the warning a vulnerable setting. This is an imaginative illustration of Jesus' metaphor, not a recorded animal encounter; Jesus is outside the image.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Sunlit watercolor garden with purple grapes on a wooden trellis, a fig tree, and a basket of fruit on a rock. Bare thorns and purple-flowered spiny thistles frame the foreground; olive trees, golden hills, and distant stone buildings lie beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined garden makes Jesus' comparison visible: grapes grow on a vine and figs on a fig tree, while separate thornbushes and thistles bear neither. The basket suggests gathering fruit; the setting illustrates the teaching rather than recording an event.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two fig trees stand on a sunlit rocky hillside: a leafy, healthy tree bears plump green and purple figs, while a hollow, withered tree carries shriveled, spoiled fruit. Fallen figs lie beneath it; a small village and blue hills appear beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined Galilean orchard gives visible form to the verse's contrast: sound tree and good fruit, corrupt tree and bad fruit. Figs, hillside and village are illustrative choices, not details specified by the verse; the scene does not claim to depict an event.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of two fig trees beside a winding stony path: a leafy tree on the left bears plump purple figs, while a hollow, sparsely leafed tree on the right bears shriveled brown fruit. Sunlit hills, stone walls and a distant village fill the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The imagined orchard places healthy and decayed trees together so their contrasting fruit illustrates the verse's two impossibilities. Fig trees and the landscape are artistic choices, not details specified by the Greek; this illustrates the teaching rather than a historical event.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A freshly cut stump stands beside a severed, fruitless tree burning with bright orange flames and rising gray smoke. Fruit-bearing trees line limestone terraces behind it, with blue hills beneath a warm golden sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined orchard makes both actions in the verse visible: the fruitless tree has been cut down and placed in fire. The surrounding fruit-bearing trees provide a visual contrast. The orchard, light, and arrangement are artistic choices, not details of a recorded event.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Warm watercolor of two fig trees beside a low stone terrace. A linen-sleeved hand supports plump purple-green figs among broad healthy leaves; the neighboring tree bears shriveled dark figs and sparse yellowing leaves. Wildflowers and golden hills fill the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined orchard illustrates recognition by fruit: the ripe and shriveled figs make the different condition of the two trees visible. The trees point to the verse's teaching about recognizing people by what they produce. The examining hand belongs to an unnamed observer; this is an illustration of the teaching, not a claim that the verse records an orchard visit.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man raises one hand while a kneeling woman offers an earthen cup to a seated elderly traveler. Flowering vines frame an arch opening onto olive trees and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard places a speaking gesture beside attentive service to suggest the verse's contrast between professing allegiance and doing the Father's will. The garden opening evokes entering the kingdom without depicting heaven or a judgment. The cup is an illustrative act of obedience, not an assertion that this one deed earns salvation; none of the figures represents Jesus or the Father.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A watercolor crowd in ancient robes looks toward someone beyond the right edge. An elderly bearded man extends both palms, a man touches his chest, and a woman and younger man raise open hands. More people gather across a sunlit limestone hillside beneath a golden sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The pleading crowd imagines the many addressing the Lord on "that day." Their open hands and hand-to-chest gestures suggest their appeal to deeds done in His name. The limestone setting and individual faces are artistic choices; no miracle is reenacted, no verdict is pictured, and Jesus remains outside the frame.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three robed men walk away along a sunlit rocky path among olive trees. The nearest looks back with a troubled expression, the middle man bows his head, and the third continues toward distant hills and a small village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The three departing men imaginatively express the separation in Jesus' command to those practicing lawlessness. Jesus remains outside the picture. The hillside, path and village are an illustrative setting, not details supplied by this verse; the men's clothing does not identify their wrongdoing. The sober faces reflect the gravity of his declaration that he never knew them.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A kneeling builder in cream and brown carefully sets a stone in the wall of an unfinished limestone house on a broad rock ledge. Olive branches, small flowers and distant hills surround the sunlit building.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined building scene visualizes the wise man in Jesus' comparison. The house rests directly on solid rock, while the builder's careful work evokes putting Jesus' words into practice. The setting and the builder's appearance are artistic choices, not details supplied by the verse. Jesus is not depicted.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An ochre stone house with closed wooden shutters stands on broad bedrock amid driving rain. Muddy floodwater foams against the rock and lower walls, while olive trees bend beneath purple-gray storm clouds.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined house illustrates the teaching through the visible connection between its foundation and solid rock. Rain, rushing floodwater, and bent trees convey the forces that strike it, while the upright house shows that it does not fall. The architecture, landscape, and colors are artistic choices; the verse does not identify a particular house or storm.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in a cream tunic and rust-colored wrap stands with hands on hips beside a flat-roofed stone house resting on rippled sand. A bowl and trowel sit by its wall; sparse grasses, low hills and a blue sky surround the sunlit dwelling.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined parable scene places an intact house directly on loose sand to picture the foolish builder in Jesus' comparison. The builder's satisfied stance is an artistic inference; it does not show the act of hearing or refusing to obey. Jesus remains outside the picture, and the storm and collapse of the following verse are not depicted.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A watercolor of a ruined ochre house in a storm. Broken roof beams and collapsed masonry lie in foaming brown floodwater beneath diagonal rain. An olive tree and foreground reeds bend in the wind, with gray-purple clouds and hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined ancient house visualizes the verse's rain, torrents, winds, and great collapse. The ruined walls and broken roof make the fall unmistakable. The architecture and landscape are artistic choices; the scene does not claim to document an actual disaster or depict its inhabitants. Jesus remains outside the image. Human artwork review is pending.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A warm watercolor shows a crowd in earth-toned robes seated on a rocky hillside beneath olive branches. An elderly man, a woman in an ochre veil and a bearded man gaze beyond the frame with parted lips and lifted brows; hills and a village recede behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The listeners' lifted brows, parted lips and still hands imagine the crowds' astonishment after Jesus finished speaking. He remains outside the frame, keeping attention on the response named in the verse. The hillside, olive trees, village, clothing and individual faces are artistic reconstruction; this verse does not specify those details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Modestly robed adults and a child sit beneath an olive tree, listening toward the left with thoughtful faces and gentle smiles. A closed scroll and reed pen rest on a foreground rock. Wildflowers, sunlit hills and blue water complete the textured watercolor scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The listeners' shared gaze toward a teacher beyond the frame imaginatively pictures Jesus teaching with authority while leaving him unseen. The closed scroll and reed pen recall the scribes mentioned in the verse without implying contempt for Scripture. The hillside, individuals and possessions are illustrative choices, not details supplied by this verse. Human artwork review remains pending.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man with pale skin patches kneels on a rocky path beneath an olive tree, wearing an ochre robe and cream mantle. He lifts both open hands and looks earnestly toward the right, with sunlit hills behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The kneeling posture and open hands imaginatively express the man's worship and appeal to be cleansed. His gaze is directed toward Jesus beyond the right edge, keeping Him outside the picture. The hillside setting and clothing are artistic choices, not details specified in this verse. The scene shows the request, before any answer or healing.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in a sand-colored tunic and russet wrap looks upward with tearful relief, one hand against his chest. A hand from an ivory sleeve rests on his shoulder. An olive tree, sunlit rocky path, distant hills and stone buildings surround him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: Jesus remains unseen except for the hand touching the man's shoulder, an indirect depiction of the touch stated in the verse. The man's healthy skin and grateful expression imagine the immediate cleansing. The hillside, olive tree, buildings and clothing are illustrative setting details, not details supplied by this verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in a brown cloak carries a cloth-covered basket toward an elderly gray-bearded man in white linen and a wrapped head covering, who extends open hands from a sunlit stone doorway. Olive branches shade the courtyard, with distant hillside houses under blue sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined visit illustrates the response Jesus commands: going quietly to the priest with the prescribed gift. The verse gives the instruction, not an account of its fulfillment. The covered basket suggests an offering without specifying its contents; the courtyard, clothing and gestures are imaginative details. Jesus remains outside the frame.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A watercolor centurion in mail armor, a cream tunic, and a red cloak leans forward with one palm extended, holding a helmet at his waist. He stands on a sunlit stone lane beside plaster walls and clay jars, with a blue lake and hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The centurion's forward step, concerned expression, and open hand imaginatively express his approach and earnest appeal in Matthew 8:5. Jesus remains outside the frame in the direction of his gaze. The clothing, lane, buildings, and lake are imagined historical setting; the picture does not specify his request or depict a later healing.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A distressed bearded man lies on a woven bed, wearing a linen tunic beneath an ochre blanket. His eyes are closed and brow furrowed, with one hand resting beside him. Warm window light enters the stone room; a clay cup and folded cloth sit beside the bed.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined household view depicts the servant's condition reported in Matthew 8:6. His pained face and still body suggest severe suffering and paralysis. Jesus and the speaker remain outside the scene. The room, cup, cloth and daylight are artistic choices, not details supplied by the verse. No healing is shown.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of a bearded Roman officer in armor and a russet cloak, one hand over his chest, looking up to the left on a sunlit stone village lane. A crested helmet rests on a ledge beside a clay jar; olive branches, flowers and distant hills surround him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The officer listening with a hand over his heart imagines the hope awakened by Jesus' promise. The village lane and home suggest the promised coming; his expression and the setting are artistic choices. Jesus remains outside the image, and no completed healing is shown.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded Roman centurion in bronze armor and a rust-red cloak holds a plumed helmet and extends one open hand beside a sunlit stone house. An olive tree, potted flowers and distant cypresses frame the warm watercolor village scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The inclined head, removed helmet and open hand imaginatively express the centurion's humility and confidence. The house recalls his words about his roof; the verse does not specify this setting or gesture. He addresses Jesus beyond the frame, and the servant's future healing is not shown.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A Roman officer gestures toward an approaching soldier in a sunlit stone courtyard. Another soldier walks out through an arch, while a servant pours water into a basin beneath grapevines.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard brings together the speaker's examples of delegated authority. The approaching and departing soldiers and the servant's ordinary task visualize obedience to his word; they are not asserted to be simultaneous events. Jesus is kept out of view.
